sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 7704 of 2023
Petitioner :- Smt Nargis

Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 9 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Shahnawaz Akhtar

Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Surendra Singh-I,J.
1. Heard Ms. Rajshree Malviya holding brief of Sri Shahnawaz Akhtar, learned counsel for the
petitioner and learned A.G.A. for the State respondents.
2.

The present petition has been filed seeking following reliefs :
"(a) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding the respondents no. 2 and 3 to do fair and early investigation in connection of first information report dated 14.04.2023 in Case Crime No. 0209/2023 under Section 498A, 304B, 201 IPC and 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station Sahaswan, District Budaun.
Smt Nargis vs State Of U.P. And 9 Others on 19 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/93323971/
1 (b) Issue any other writ, order or direction in the nature of which this Hon'ble Court deems fit and proper in the interest of justice.

entities.text: D.P. Act, Police Station Sahaswan, District Budaun
entities.label: STATUTE

entities.text: Smt Nargis vs State Of U.P. And 9 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: (c) Cost and damage may be awarded."

3. From perusal of the record, we find that the first information report in the present case was lodged on 14.04.2023 and the present petition was filed on 04.05.2023 even before expiry of one month and therefore, we are of the opinion that the petitioner shown undue haste in filing the present petition.
4. Present petition is accordingly dismissed at this stage.
5.
However, the petitioner is at liberty to avail the remedy as may be available to her in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 19.5.2023 Pratima  Smt Nargis vs State Of U.P. And 9 Others on 19 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/93323971/
